narrative.overview: Parchment thinking space framed by compact Night navigation and an unchanged-original band. Selected formulations, saved user contributions, canonical responses and confirmed developing ideas lead. The retained inquiry-flow mockups guide composition, not raster coordinates or fabricated relationships. The web presentation correction awaits independent behavior and visual review. DESIGN.md and application CSS describe the current result; obsolete dark-workspace documentation specimens have been removed.
keyCharacteristics: Original words distinct from attributed hypotheses.
Temporary search results and connected reading, not permanent note management.

rules.name: The Source Distinction Rule
rules.body: Keep original text distinct from tentative AI formulations; color never replaces the author or status label.

dos: Do preserve the exact core palette and self-hosted task font.
Do keep author, source, status, and evidence readable without spatial gestures.
Do use familiar semantic controls within inquiry-centered navigation.
donts: Don't imply that saved, queued, tentative, active, and user-endorsed mean the same thing.
Don't add a permanent notes list, chat sidebar, new logo, or literal textile/fantasy ornament.

Don't imply an unconfigured worker is running or mistake agent prose for a durable change. Follow the retained mockups' composition without inventing their illustrative relationships, headlines or approval actions.
